div.p: This value set includes codes based on the following rules:

ul.li: Import all the codes that are contained in MII VS ICU Code Kontraindikation

Include these codes as defined in https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-icu/CodeSystem/mii-cs-icu-dgai version 📦2027.0.0
CodeDisplayDefinition
parenteral-nutrition-in-progressParenteral nutrition currently being administeredAssessment of whether parenteral nutrition is actually being administered at the effective time or throughout the effective period; the code identifies the assessment question and does not itself assert that administration is in progress. This is not an order, indication or contraindication assessment.
